items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: They got Count Basie, they got some of his men out of his band, quite a few they got -- marijuana

ctx.x: Naturally, if you do me a favor I'm obligated to you. If you do me a favor I'm obligated. That was a terrible thing then, smoking marijuana. And at that time they made it bad -- so bad that they don't want you doing nothing but serve time for doing it. So if Joe Glaser can keep him out of jail and squash it down I think I'd be indebted to him, too. Why wouldn't you? Well, that's what will happen. But Louis Armstrong paid the price for that. Then comes Charlie Barnet, then comes the rest of them. Benny Goodman is…

They got Count Basie, they got some of his men out of his band, quite a few they got -- marijuana and it's now almost a legalized drug. Just shows to go ya, what the world turns out to be. It's terrible, the world is in a bad state.
